addStickiesOnYourOwn: Add stickies on your own: nobody sees them until they are revealed.
readEverythingThenMoveSimilar: Read everything, then move similar stickies together.
voteOnWhatToTalk: Vote on what to talk about. Votes stay hidden until the end.
talkThroughTheTopicsWith: Talk through the topics with the most votes, top first.
turnWhatYouAgreedInto: Turn what you agreed into action items, each with an owner.
useWhatIsOnThe: Use what is on the board
fiveStepsWriteOnYour: Five steps: write on your own, reveal and group, vote, discuss, agree on actions. You move everyone along.
participantsAddOnlyStickiesUntil: Participants add only stickies until the action step
privateModeIsAlreadyRunning: Private mode is already running. Reveal it first: the retro runs its own.
aVoteIsAlreadyRunning: A vote is already running ({title}). End it first: the retro runs its own vote.
